<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Coin Hopper</title>
<style>html,body{margin:0;background:#111;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh}</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<script>
const T = 32;
const LEVELS = [
  [
    ".........................",
    ".........................",
    ".........................",
    "...................G.....",
    "..................###....",
    ".........................",
    "........C.C.............",
    ".......#####......C......",
    ".........................",
    ".....C.........#####.....",
    "....###..................",
    ".........................",
    "..........C..E....C......",
    ".P.......................",
    "#########################",
  ],
  [
    ".........................",
    ".........................",
    ".........................",
    ".G.......................",
    ".###.....................",
    ".....C...................",
    "....####..........C......",
    "..................#####..",
    "..............C..........",
    "....#####...#####........",
    ".........................",
    "..C.................C....",
    ".........................",
    ".P.........E.............",
    "####....#####...#########",
  ],
];
// Level 2 enemy sits on the middle platform instead of the ground
LEVELS[1][13] = ".P.......................";
LEVELS[1][8] = "..............C..E.......";

class Game extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Game'); }
  init(d) { this.lvl = (d && d.level) || 0; }

  create() {
    if (this.lvl === 0 && !this.registry.has('total')) this.registry.set('total', 0);
    if (this.lvl === 0) this.registry.set('total', 0);
    this.makeTextures();
    const map = LEVELS[this.lvl];
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#87ceeb');
    this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, 800, 480);
    this.ground = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.coins = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.enemies = this.physics.add.group();
    this.collected = 0; this.total = 0; this.dead = false;
    let start = { x: 64, y: 400 };

    map.forEach((row, r) => [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      const x = c * T + T / 2, y = r * T + T / 2;
      if (ch === '#') this.ground.create(x, y, 'tile');
      else if (ch === 'C') { this.coins.create(x, y, 'coin'); this.total++; }
      else if (ch === 'P') start = { x, y };
      else if (ch === 'G') this.goal = this.physics.add.staticImage(x, y, 'flag');
      else if (ch === 'E') {
        const e = this.enemies.create(x, y, 'enemy');
        e.startX = x; e.setVelocityX(60); e.setCollideWorldBounds(true);
      }
    }));
    this.ground.refresh(); this.coins.refresh();

    this.player = this.physics.add.sprite(start.x, start.y, 'player');
    this.player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);
    this.player.body.setMaxVelocityY(700);
    this.jumps = 0;

    this.physics.add.collider(this.player, this.ground);
    this.physics.add.collider(this.enemies, this.ground);
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.coins, (p, c) => {
      c.destroy(); this.collected++; this.updateHud();
    });
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.enemies, (p, e) => this.hitEnemy(p, e));
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.goal, () => this.reachGoal());

    this.keys = this.input.keyboard.addKeys({
      left: 'LEFT', right: 'RIGHT', up: 'UP', a: 'A', d: 'D', w: 'W', space: 'SPACE'
    });
    this.hud = this.add.text(12, 10, '', { fontSize: '20px', color: '#000', fontFamily: 'monospace' });
    this.msg = this.add.text(400, 60, '', { fontSize: '22px', color: '#c00', fontFamily: 'monospace' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.updateHud();
  }

  updateHud() {
    this.hud.setText(`Level ${this.lvl + 1}/${LEVELS.length}   Coins ${this.collected}/${this.total}`);
  }

  makeTextures() {
    if (this.textures.exists('tile')) return;
    const g = this.make.graphics({ add: false });
    g.fillStyle(0x6b4423).fillRect(0, 0, 32, 32).fillStyle(0x3cb043).fillRect(0, 0, 32, 8);
    g.generateTexture('tile', 32, 32); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0x2255dd).fillRect(0, 0, 24, 30).fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(14, 6, 6, 6);
    g.generateTexture('player', 24, 30); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0xffd700).fillCircle(8, 8, 8).lineStyle(2, 0xb8860b).strokeCircle(8, 8, 7);
    g.generateTexture('coin', 16, 16); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0xcc2222).fillRect(0, 0, 28, 24).fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(5, 6, 6, 6).fillRect(17, 6, 6, 6);
    g.generateTexture('enemy', 28, 24); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0x444444).fillRect(14, 0, 4, 32).fillStyle(0xff8800).fillTriangle(18, 2, 18, 16, 32, 9);
    g.generateTexture('flag', 32, 32); g.destroy();
  }

  hitEnemy(p, e) {
    if (this.dead) return;
    if (p.body.velocity.y > 0 && p.body.bottom - e.body.top < 14) {
      e.destroy(); p.setVelocityY(-300); this.jumps = 1;
    } else this.die();
  }

  die() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    this.dead = true;
    this.player.setTint(0xff0000);
    this.physics.pause();
    this.time.delayedCall(500, () => this.scene.restart({ level: this.lvl }));
  }

  reachGoal() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    if (this.collected < this.total) {
      this.msg.setText('Collect all coins first!');
      this.time.delayedCall(1200, () => this.msg.setText(''));
      return;
    }
    this.dead = true;
    this.registry.inc('total', this.collected);
    if (this.lvl + 1 < LEVELS.length) this.scene.restart({ level: this.lvl + 1 });
    else this.scene.start('Win');
  }

  update() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    const p = this.player, k = this.keys;
    const left = k.left.isDown || k.a.isDown, right = k.right.isDown || k.d.isDown;
    p.setVelocityX(left ? -190 : right ? 190 : 0);
    if (left) p.setFlipX(true); else if (right) p.setFlipX(false);

    const onFloor = p.body.blocked.down;
    if (onFloor) this.jumps = 0;
    const pressed = Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.up) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.w) ||
                    Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.space);
    if (pressed) {
      if (!onFloor && this.jumps === 0) this.jumps = 1; // walked off ledge: only one air jump left
      if (this.jumps < 2) { p.setVelocityY(-420); this.jumps++; }
    }
    // variable jump height
    if (!(k.up.isDown || k.w.isDown || k.space.isDown) && p.body.velocity.y < -150) p.setVelocityY(-150);

    this.enemies.getChildren().forEach(e => {
      if (e.body.blocked.left) e.setVelocityX(60);
      else if (e.body.blocked.right) e.setVelocityX(-60);
      else if (e.x > e.startX + 80) e.setVelocityX(-60);
      else if (e.x < e.startX - 80) e.setVelocityX(60);
    });

    if (p.y > 470) this.die();
  }
}

class Win extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Win'); }
  create() {
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#222244');
    const st = { fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#fff' };
    this.add.text(400, 170, 'YOU WIN!', { ...st, fontSize: '64px', color: '#ffd700' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.add.text(400, 250, `Coins collected: ${this.registry.get('total')}`, { ...st, fontSize: '26px' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.add.text(400, 320, 'Press SPACE or click to play again', { ...st, fontSize: '20px' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    const again = () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0 });
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-SPACE', again);
    this.input.once('pointerdown', again);
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO, width: 800, height: 480, parent: document.body,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 900 } } },
  scene: [Game, Win],
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const T = 32;
const LEVELS = [
  [
    ".........................",
    ".........................",
    ".........................",
    "...................G.....",
    "..................###....",
    ".........................",
    "........C.C.............",
    ".......#####......C......",
    ".........................",
    ".....C.........#####.....",
    "....###..................",
    ".........................",
    "..........C..E....C......",

    ".....C...................",
    "....####..........C......",
    "..................#####..",
    "..............C..........",
    "....#####...#####........",
    ".........................",
    "..C.................C....",
    ".........................",
    ".P.........E.............",
    "####....#####...#########",
  ],
];

LEVELS[1][13] = ".P.......................";
LEVELS[1][8] = "..............C..E.......";

class Game extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Game'); }
  init(d) { this.lvl = (d && d.level) || 0; }

  create() {
    if (this.lvl === 0 && !this.registry.has('total')) this.registry.set('total', 0);
    if (this.lvl === 0) this.registry.set('total', 0);
    this.makeTextures();
    const map = LEVELS[this.lvl];
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#87ceeb');
    this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, 800, 480);
    this.ground = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.coins = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.enemies = this.physics.add.group();
    this.collected = 0; this.total = 0; this.dead = false;
    let start = { x: 64, y: 400 };

    map.forEach((row, r) => [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      const x = c * T + T / 2, y = r * T + T / 2;
      if (ch === '#') this.ground.create(x, y, 'tile');
      else if (ch === 'C') { this.coins.create(x, y, 'coin'); this.total++; }
      else if (ch === 'P') start = { x, y };
      else if (ch === 'G') this.goal = this.physics.add.staticImage(x, y, 'flag');
      else if (ch === 'E') {
        const e = this.enemies.create(x, y, 'enemy');
        e.startX = x; e.setVelocityX(60); e.setCollideWorldBounds(true);
      }
    }));
    this.ground.refresh(); this.coins.refresh();

    this.player = this.physics.add.sprite(start.x, start.y, 'player');
    this.player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);
    this.player.body.setMaxVelocityY(700);
    this.jumps = 0;

    this.physics.add.collider(this.player, this.ground);
    this.physics.add.collider(this.enemies, this.ground);
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.coins, (p, c) => {
      c.destroy(); this.collected++; this.updateHud();
    });
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.enemies, (p, e) => this.hitEnemy(p, e));
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.goal, () => this.reachGoal());

    this.keys = this.input.keyboard.addKeys({
      left: 'LEFT', right: 'RIGHT', up: 'UP', a: 'A', d: 'D', w: 'W', space: 'SPACE'
    });
    this.hud = this.add.text(12, 10, '', { fontSize: '20px', color: '#000', fontFamily: 'monospace' });
    this.msg = this.add.text(400, 60, '', { fontSize: '22px', color: '#c00', fontFamily: 'monospace' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.updateHud();
  }

  updateHud() {
    this.hud.setText(`Level ${this.lvl + 1}/${LEVELS.length}   Coins ${this.collected}/${this.total}`);
  }

  makeTextures() {
    if (this.textures.exists('tile')) return;
    const g = this.make.graphics({ add: false });
    g.fillStyle(0x6b4423).fillRect(0, 0, 32, 32).fillStyle(0x3cb043).fillRect(0, 0, 32, 8);
    g.generateTexture('tile', 32, 32); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0x2255dd).fillRect(0, 0, 24, 30).fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(14, 6, 6, 6);
    g.generateTexture('player', 24, 30); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0xffd700).fillCircle(8, 8, 8).lineStyle(2, 0xb8860b).strokeCircle(8, 8, 7);
    g.generateTexture('coin', 16, 16); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0xcc2222).fillRect(0, 0, 28, 24).fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(5, 6, 6, 6).fillRect(17, 6, 6, 6);
    g.generateTexture('enemy', 28, 24); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0x444444).fillRect(14, 0, 4, 32).fillStyle(0xff8800).fillTriangle(18, 2, 18, 16, 32, 9);
    g.generateTexture('flag', 32, 32); g.destroy();
  }

  hitEnemy(p, e) {
    if (this.dead) return;
    if (p.body.velocity.y > 0 && p.body.bottom - e.body.top < 14) {
      e.destroy(); p.setVelocityY(-300); this.jumps = 1;
    } else this.die();
  }

  die() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    this.dead = true;
    this.player.setTint(0xff0000);
    this.physics.pause();
    this.time.delayedCall(500, () => this.scene.restart({ level: this.lvl }));
  }

  reachGoal() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    if (this.collected < this.total) {
      this.msg.setText('Collect all coins first!');
      this.time.delayedCall(1200, () => this.msg.setText(''));
      return;
    }
    this.dead = true;
    this.registry.inc('total', this.collected);
    if (this.lvl + 1 < LEVELS.length) this.scene.restart({ level: this.lvl + 1 });
    else this.scene.start('Win');
  }

  update() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    const p = this.player, k = this.keys;

                    Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.space);
    if (pressed) {
      if (!onFloor && this.jumps === 0) this.jumps = 1; // walked off ledge: only one air jump left
      if (this.jumps < 2) { p.setVelocityY(-420); this.jumps++; }
    }
    // variable jump height
    if (!(k.up.isDown || k.w.isDown || k.space.isDown) && p.body.velocity.y < -150) p.setVelocityY(-150);

    this.enemies.getChildren().forEach(e => {
      if (e.body.blocked.left) e.setVelocityX(60);
      else if (e.body.blocked.right) e.setVelocityX(-60);
      else if (e.x > e.startX + 80) e.setVelocityX(-60);
      else if (e.x < e.startX - 80) e.setVelocityX(60);
    });

    if (p.y > 470) this.die();
  }
}

    const st = { fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#fff' };

    this.add.text(400, 250, `Coins collected: ${this.registry.get('total')}`, { ...st, fontSize: '26px' }).setOrigin(0.5);
